candidate_reports.remark: Total snowfall since 8 am 5.2 inches. Liquid Eq: 0.89 inches.
Cocorahs reporter mentions first real snow of the season. Most melted as it landed. Elevation 799 ft.
Rain yesterday_ moderate intensity at times. Light rain_ mixing with a few snowflakes at obs time this morning. The snow liquid equivalent was also a Trace.

A cloudy day with the first snowfall of the season and a high of 35 F. The day presented a mix of rain and snow_ most of which melted on contact with the ground. Night skies remained cloudy and the temperature dipped to 32 F. Currently it is cloudy and 34 F with calm winds. The barometer is 29.82 inHg and steady. 0.43 inches in the gauge.
CoCoRaHS report: 0.25 inches of precipitation_ 34 degrees F_ cloudy.
.72 inches of rain_ 39.7F_ drizzle_ overcast.
Updates previous report. 4.3 inches of new snow between 10am and 5pm. Total 33 hour snowfall 9.5 inches. Snow depth 9 inches.
35.4 degrees F_ sunny_ clear.
The Shemya AWOS recorded a wind gust of 75 mph at 1:55 pm.
8 to 10 inches of heavy wet snow since last night. He reported it was still snowing.
Gusts of 60 mph or greater were observed between 2:07 PM and 10:42 PM. The peak of the event occurred between about 6 PM and 10 PM.
Gusts of 60 mph or greater occurred between 7 PM and 11:30 PM.
Raining_ 38.7 degrees F.
Overcast_ 42.4 degrees F.
35.2 degrees F_ partly cloudy.
4.5 inches of snow and 0.78 inches of precipitation reported.
3 inches of snow overnight. Still snowing now.

CoCoRaHS observer remarks about the previous 24 hr - A rainy with gusty winds in the morning and a high of 36 F. Overnight rain continued_ turning to snow after midnight and a low of 32 F. Currently it is 32 F and snowing with south winds at 1 mph. The barometer is 29.13 inHg and steady. The rain gauge measured 0.82 inch_ snowfall was 0.6 inch_ SWE was 0.13 inch_ and snow depth was 0.5 inch at the time of report.
Fine wet snow continuing to fall. By eye minimal accumulation over the past two hours so most had fallen by 5:30 am.

CoCoRaHS observer also reports at the time of observation that light snow falling_ light E breeze_ temp. and low 31.5F_ barometer 29.07. Gauge had 0.39 inches of water from rain and funnel was overflowing with snow_ of which 0.19 inches of water for the total of 0.58 inches of precipitation.
At the time of report_ cocorahs observer reported 0.51 inch of precipitation with 5.8 inches of snowfall. Snow depth of 6 inches.

0.40 inch precip was in the liquid gauge catch. 0.45 inch SWE is from snow on snowboard. Mixed heavy rain and snow periods through night_ and snowing at the time of observation. Also at the time of observation_ cocorahs observer reported 32 F._ wind 0 mph_ barometer 29.24 falling_ and low continuous cloud cover.
Cocorahs observer reported 0.1 inches of precipitation measured_ 1.8 inches of snowfall_ and 2 inches snow depth.
snow was heavy and wet.
Less than one inch. Snow started yesterday 10/19 in the morning. Switched to rain in the afternoon but there is still some very saturated snow on the ground.
cocorahs observer reported 0.16 inches of Rain_ Sky: Few Cumulus Barometric Pressure: 29.18 (988) Temperature: 57 F (high 41 F/low 34 F).

For the official 18Z observation_ the office observed 0.15 inches of precipitation_ 0.3 inches of heavy wet snow_ and trace of snow on the ground. 0.3 inches of snow was measured at 0630 local time and snow was continuing to fall_ but snow was compacting and melting after that time. Snow changed over to rain sometime between 0800 and 0900 local time.
Heavy wet snowfall. Temperatures now above freezing and little to no precipitation falling at this time.

Started as rain around midnight. Switched over to snow early this morning with 3 inches max depth of snow around 0900_ but as temperatures rose above freezing_ measured 2 inches at the time of report. Water content 0.64 inches_ including the rain and snow total from midnight.
Waterspout observed over Turnagain Arm a couple miles southwest of Potter Marsh with a duration of at least 10 minutes. Pictures provided. Radar observed rotation as well.
ASOS/AWOS reported a 73 mph gust at 11:55 AM.
Wind gust 70 mph at 1:30pm.
Wind gust 74 mph at 1:30pm.
Continued to hit intermittent 60+ mph gusts through 3PM local time. Measured from ASOS/AWOS.
Bethel ASOS/AWOS consistently measured 50 to 60 mph gusts in a short window between 7:53PM_ Oct 25 to 8:53PM_ Oct 25.
Shemya ASOS/AWOS recorded a sustained wind at 59 mph and a gust of 78 mph at 2:59AM_ Oct. 26th. One hour later_ the station recorded a sustained wind of 61 mph and a gust of 77 mph.
Large treen down near Donna Dr & Peppertree Loop. Time estimated based on the timing of strongest wind gusts in the area.
